parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

useNodeCloudIdentity.description: If true query and use current compute instance's Cloud Identity (e.g. AWS IAM Role).

accessKey.description:
Identifier of the secret key returned when creating a service account.
Equivalent to com.box.sdk.BoxConfig publicKeyId.

secretKey.description:
Service account secret key
Equivalent to com.box.sdk.BoxConfig privateKey.
A sample is provided below:
"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
MII...
...
...==
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"

accountId.description:
Client ID of the service account used to generate the publix private key pair.
Equivalent to com.box.sdk.BoxConfig clientId.

cloudIdentity.description:
Cloud service native identity for managing access to Cloud Resources. It is typically associated with compute
instance.

endpoint.description: Endpoint for accessing resources (e.g. Kubernetes API server endpoint).

description.description: Customized description for the cloud resource credential.

certificate.description: Tls Certificate if this Cloud Resource needs a secure connection

enterpriseId.description: The ID of the enterprise that the user is a part of

clientSecret.description: The secret password for OAuth authentication

privateKeyPassword.description: Passphrase to access the public key (Optional)

userId.description: The ID of the user whose account is be authorized

accessToken.description: Access Token for your Box app.

refreshToken.description: Refresh Token for your Box app.

lastRefresh.description: The time in milliseconds that the token was refreshed (used for OAuth).

expires.description: The time in milliseconds the access token will last after being refreshed (used for OAuth).
